title: Spokane-Area Fred's Appliance and Victory Media Allegedly Used AI-Assisted Voice Editing Without Spokeswoman's Consent

behaviors.text: George said the ads were created without her knowledge or consent.

Spokane-area appliance retailer Fred's Appliance and production company Victory Media allegedly used AI-assisted editing to alter the voice of a person, the longtime spokeswoman for Fred's Appliance, in advertisements assembled from earlier footage.
